propositions: configure_logging() sets propagate=False on the shared 'rebar' logger process-globally without restoration, causing caplog to silently fail to capture rebar.* records in subsequent tests within the same process

The propagate=False mutation prevents pytest.logging's capture handler from reaching rebar.* loggers in the test phase where the mutation occurs, resulting in StopIteration or empty caplog.records assertions
Test suite exhibits order-dependent intermittent failures where caplog assertions pass in isolation but fail when run after another test that calls configure_logging()

The false positive concern about double-logging through uvicorn/root is unfounded because uvicorn only configures uvicorn.* loggers and adds no root handler, and the marker-guarded handler is installed at most once anyway
Removing the propagate=False mutation preserves the existing double-logging guard tests while restoring caplog visibility to rebar.* loggers across all test runs
